tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run JavaScript code to orchestrate/compose tool calls. All nested tools are available on the global `tools` object, for example `await tools.exec_command(...)`. exec_command takes {cmd, workdir, yield_time_ms, max_output_tokens}: workdir is the directory to run the command in.
